Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 325 as introduced would allow for the State Board of Registration for Foresters to sell marketable and promotional items, which would increase receipts to the Professional Foresters Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount and sale price of marketing and promotional items sold.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 325 as passed the House of Representatives would allow for the State Board of Registration for Foresters to sell marketable and promotional items, which would increase receipts to the Professional Foresters Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount and sale price of marketing and promotional items sold.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
